review.notes: All 7 physical pages diffed as extracted text against the OCR markdown and the flagged spots re-read on renders (110 dpi full pages; 300 dpi crops of the Eval Methodology bullets and both table header rows). Both printed title lines are genuine (cover p.1 'Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image / Model Card' plus inner title page p.2 'Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image - Model Card'), so the two H1 lines are not a duplication defect. 'SxS human eval' is printed with S glyphs in the PDF (side-by-side eval), so the OCR reading is correct and was not patched. The only page-1 raster image is the Google logo; the card prints no content figures, so no image embeds are missing. All capability-table values spot-checked against the rendered tables and matched, including the wrapped 'GPT 2 / Respon / se API / Low' header, which the OCR joined with a duplicated 'se'.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.4 prints the same acronym with a capital I everywhere: 'diverse Text-to-Image (T2I)', 'T2I: General Text-to-Image, i18n Text Rendering, Visual Design.', and table rows 'General T2I' / 'Social Media Trends - T2I' (re-read at 300 dpi; the OCR itself transcribes all the other occurrences as T2I). The bullet line's lowercase l is an OCR inconsistency, not source text.

Rendered physical p.4 shows 'Eval Methodology' as a bold top-level bullet ('• Eval Methodology') under the Approach list, at the same level as the preceding '• Capabilities / Benchmarks' item which the OCR rendered as the list line '\- Capabilities / Benchmarks cover...'. The OCR incorrectly promoted this bullet to a level-2 heading; demoted to the same list-line style as its sibling.

Both table header rows (physical p.4 Text-to-Image table and p.5 Editing table) wrap the competitor column as 'GPT 2 / Respon / se API / Low', i.e. the printed text is 'GPT 2 Response API Low' (300 dpi crops). The OCR joined 'Respon'+'se' into 'Response' but kept the wrapped 'se' line as extra text, duplicating it.
